content_blocks.label: lead_paragraph
content_blocks.text: The government is under increasing pressure to reconsider its energy policies following a series of extreme weather events linked to climate change.

content_blocks.label: body_paragraph_1
content_blocks.text: Recent heatwaves and flooding have highlighted the urgent need for action on climate change, prompting calls for a shift towards renewable energy sources.

content_blocks.label: body_paragraph_2
content_blocks.text: Environment Minister Lisa Johnson said, 'We cannot continue with business as usual if we want to protect our communities and the planet.'

content_blocks.label: body_paragraph_3
content_blocks.text: Opposition parties are pushing for stricter emissions targets and incentives for green technology, while industry groups argue that such changes would be too costly and disruptive.

content_blocks.label: body_paragraph_4
content_blocks.text: Environmental activists are planning a series of protests to raise awareness about the impacts of climate change and push for stronger government action.

content_blocks.label: pull_quote
content_blocks.text: 'The time for half-measures is over. We need bold action now to combat climate change.' - Greenpeace Canada
